title: Staff Software Engineer Ruby on Rails
description:
Role Description:

This role is ideal for seasoned engineers with 8+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems, with strong expertise in Ruby on Rails and experience working with React.js and/or Angular.



The role focuses on technical leadership, architecture, engineering excellence, and solving complex, ambiguous problems while contributing to the technical direction and engineering culture of the organization.



What You'll Do:

Technical Vision & Architecture: Lead the architectural direction for complex, large-scale systems. You will balance the immediate needs of the business with long-term system health, ensuring our solutions remain simple, scalable, and resilient. 

Engineering Excellence at Scale: Champion disciplined engineering practices (TDD, Pair Programming, CI/CD) across multiple teams. You don't just follow the bar; you raise it by introducing better patterns and tooling. 

AI Strategy & Mentorship: Drive our AI-native development model. You will experiment with and define how we use AI to accelerate the SDLC, ensuring the team uses these tools to enhance—rather than replace—deep technical judgment. 

Cross-Team Leadership: Act as a force multiplier. You will mentor senior engineers, conduct high-impact code reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning and craftsmanship. 

Strategic Client Partnership: Work as a technical consultant for high-stakes client engagements, translating vague business goals into robust technical roadmaps and navigating complex stakeholder environments. 

Systemic Problem Solving: Beyond resolving production issues, you identify class-level problems in our infrastructure or codebase and implement systemic changes to eliminate them permanently. 

What We're Looking For:

8+ years of experience building and maintaining high-scale production systems. 

Mastery of Fundamentals: Expert-level understanding of object-oriented design, functional programming, and system architecture (Microservices, Event-driven, etc.). 

Polyglot Mindset: High proficiency in Ruby on Rails and React/Angular, with the proven ability to architect solutions across multiple tech stacks (Python, Go, etc.) as needed. 

Influence without Authority: Demonstrated ability to lead through persuasion and technical excellence rather than just hierarchy. 

Advanced AI Collaboration: Deep experience integrating AI into a professional workflow to explore architecture, automate toil, and peer-review logic. 

Proven Ownership: A track record of taking a project from a nebulous idea to a successful, maintained production system. 

Communication: Exceptional ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. 

Clear thinking and strong problem-solving ability, with the capacity to break down complex problems into simple, well-structured solutions.

A strong sense of ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, care deeply about quality, and are not comfortable shipping work that does not meet your standards  

What We Offer:

100% remote workHigh-impact projects & learning environment

Joining Preference:

Open to candidates who can join at the earliest.

Work Environment:

Remote-first, collaborative culture with flexibility, accountability, and continuous learning, plus occasional in-person meetups.

title: Backend Developer (Ruby on Rails)
description:
Please read this JD carefully before applying.   




Ruby on Rails Engineer | High Ownership  




4+ years of serious, hands-on Ruby on Rails experience | Remote / Hybrid  




This is a role for engineers who own outcomes, not tasks. You will be expected to take problems from unclear → solved → shipped → owned  without waiting for someone to define every step. 




You are expected to think, decide, execute, and take responsibility for the result. We value judgement over instructions, initiative over supervision, and impact over activity.  




We care less about how many years you have written Ruby and more about what you have been trusted to own. This role is for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, solves problems independently, and makes the people around them better.  




If that sounds like the kind of environment where you do your best work, keep reading.  




Note: We are a startup. The autonomy is real. So is the accountability.  




This role is for you if you:  

Are self-driven and highly motivated. You don't need someone constantly telling you what to do next. Take ownership from problem → solution → production → Monitoring Move fast. We prefer decisions and execution in hours or days, not weeks of meetings and approvals. Are comfortable in a flat, low-bureaucracy environment where engineers have significant autonomy. Think beyond your assigned task and understand the business and customer impact of what you're building. Are versatile and willing to work across different parts of the product when the problem requires it. Can operate without a rigid process or a long list of predefined instructions. Are responsive and dependable when the team needs you. We value people who find solutions rather than reasons why something cannot be done. Care about engineering quality but don't use perfect as an excuse to move slowly. Enjoy helping other engineers. You will be expected to coach teammates, review code, share knowledge, and unblock others.  


What you will do  

Build and maintain our Shopify-focused products using Ruby on Rails, React, Vanilla JS. Design, implement, test, deploy, and monitor production features. Investigate and solve difficult technical and customer-facing problems. Make technical decisions independently and explain your reasoning. Work across backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and infrastructure when necessary. Identify problems before they become incidents. Improve our codebase, systems, and engineering processes continuously. Help other engineers become better through mentoring, code reviews, and technical guidance.  


What we're looking for  

4+ years of professional Ruby on Rails experience Strong understanding of Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL and REST/API development. Experience building and maintaining production applications. Good understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals. Ability to debug complex problems independently. Strong communication and written communication. Experience working in a fast-moving product company is a strong plus. Shopify experience is a plus, but strong engineering ability matters more than Shopify experience.  


Our working style  

We deliberately keep the company flat and low-bureaucracy. There aren't layers of management between you and the problem. If something needs fixing, you can investigate it, propose a solution, make the decision, and get it done. We don't run a ticket factory where your job is to mechanically complete assigned tasks. You will have autonomy, but autonomy comes with accountability. We care much more about outcomes, ownership and impact than activity.  


You probably won't enjoy this role if...  

You need someone to tell you what to work on every morning. You prefer a predictable queue of clearly defined tickets. You frequently wait for someone else to solve blockers for you. You dislike taking responsibility when something goes wrong. You need lots of meetings, approvals and processes before making decisions. You are primarily looking for a 9-to-5 role where responsibilities end when your assigned ticket is complete. You are uncomfortable being challenged or giving and receiving direct feedback. You prefer to stay strictly within one narrow technical area.  





If you are the kind of engineer who sees a problem and thinks, I'll figure it out, we'd like to hear from you.  







Bonus  

If you have worked on Shopify Apps. Worked Previously in a Startup. Worked in Product based company.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer Intern
description:
Groww is hiring a Ruby on Rails Developer Intern in Mysuru — a hands-on, mentor-led internship built for students and 2026 freshers who want real exposure to full-stack development with Ruby on Rails rather than a certificate-only programme.

About the role
As a Ruby on Rails Developer Intern at Groww, your core focus will be building Rails features end to end, from migrations to views. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on building Rails features end to end, from migrations to views alongside the core team
• Use Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Active Record, REST APIs on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Active Record, REST APIs, HTML5 & CSS3, JavaScript, RSpec Testing, Git & GitHub, MVC Architecture — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT), BCA, MCA or B.Sc (Computer Science) based in or willing to work from Mysuru. You should be willing to learn Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 6-month internship in Mysuru, Karnataka, with a stipend of ₹22,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a Rails feature merged into a live application. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role.

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT), BCA, MCA or B.Sc (Computer Science)
• Graduating batch: 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates are both eligible
• Academics: 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; consistent academics help, but a strong project or portfolio is weighed alongside marks
• Technical skills: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Active Record, REST APIs
• Also useful: HTML5 & CSS3, JavaScript, RSpec Testing, Git & GitHub, MVC Architecture
• Soft skills: clear written and spoken English, ownership of your work, comfort asking questions, and the discipline to check your own work before you ship it
• Experience: none required — this is a fresher internship. Academic projects, certifications, GitHub work or a previous internship strengthen an application but are not mandatory
• Location: based in Mysuru, Karnataka or willing to work from there for the internship period

Additional information
• Joining date: immediate / rolling — selected candidates usually start within 3-5 weeks of accepting the offer, and start dates can be adjusted around end-semester exams
• Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard business hours (about 8-9 hours a day) at the office
• Duration: 6 months, with a certificate issued on successful completion
• Documents at joining: college ID or degree certificate, a government photo ID, and a No-Objection Certificate from your college where your programme requires one
• Equipment: a workstation, software licences and all tool access are provided at the office — you do not need to bring your own machine
• Bond: no bond and no service agreement is attached to this internship
• Fees: Groww and MyInternships.in never charge a candidate any fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. Report anyone who asks you for money in the name of this internship

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Groww's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on building Rails features end to end, from migrations to views alongside the core team; Apply Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Active Record to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT), BCA, MCA or B.Sc (Computer Science); Graduating batch 2026 or 2027 — final-year students and recent graduates welcome; 60% / 6.0 CGPA and above preferred; strong project work is considered alongside academics; Working knowledge of Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Exposure to Active Record, REST APIs, HTML5 & CSS3 is an advantage; Clear written and verbal communication in English, and care with detail in your work; No prior work experience required — this is a fresher-friendly internship; Based in Mysuru, Karnataka or willing to work from there for the internship period.
